scenario.title: Cold Night at Kaaljhar Post
scenario.setting_summary: Kaaljhar Weather Post sits high in Ladakh, cut off by snow. Five people share one heated building, and tonight one of them is dead.
background: It is February 2026 at Kaaljhar Weather Post in Ladakh.
The post sits at 4,600 metres. Only six people live here in winter.
A storm closed the road three days ago. Nobody can come or leave.
The station director, Dr. Meher Qureshi, was 52 and strict but fair.
At about 11:20 pm, Meher was found dead in the snow outside the generator shed.
Outside it is minus 28 degrees. A person without a coat dies there in minutes.
Everyone knows the generator shed door bolts from the outside only.
Everyone knows the radio is the only link to the valley, and it is logged.

public_timeline.event: Dinner in the mess hall. All six people are present.
Meher goes to her office alone and shuts the door.
A short radio call goes out on the inside handsets.
The outer door opens and shuts. Nobody says they heard it.
Meher is found face down in the snow by the shed.
The body is moved inside. It is already frozen stiff.

scenario.opening_scene: The wind has not stopped for three days. In the mess hall the lamp swings a little. Meher Qureshi lies on the long table under a grey blanket, still in her indoor jacket. Her boots are unlaced. Outside, the generator shed door stands open and the snow by it is scraped flat. The road will not open for another week. Whoever did this is sitting in this room.
scenario.case_question: Who killed Dr. Meher Qureshi at Kaaljhar Post, and why?

truth.summary: Nikhil Sodhi killed Meher Qureshi. He had learned that "Meher Qureshi" was really Sunita Rathod, the engineer blamed for the Chotila mine wall collapse of 2016. Nine workers died there, including Nikhil's elder brother. Nikhil called her to the generator shed at 10:35 pm, hit her head with a steel torch inside the doorway, dragged her outside and bolted the door. She froze to death in minutes.

timeline.event: Dinner. Nikhil watches Meher and makes up his mind.

Rishabh enters Meher's office to try the safe. She is awake and groggy. She notes it in her diary.
Himanshu makes a private radio call to his wife in Leh, which is against the rules.
Nikhil calls Meher on the inside handset and asks her to check the shed heater.
Meher walks out without her outer coat. Nikhil hits her head inside the shed doorway with a steel torch.
Nikhil drags her out into the snow, bolts the shed door, and walks back in his heavy boots.
Nikhil wipes the torch with kerosene and hides it in his locker.
Himanshu deletes ten minutes of radio log to hide his private call. The server keeps a copy.
Priya goes out for coal and finds the body.

truth.method: A blow to the head with a steel torch inside the shed doorway, then dragging her outside and bolting the door so she froze.
truth.motive: Revenge. Meher was really Sunita Rathod, the engineer blamed for the mine collapse that killed Nikhil's brother in 2016.
truth.ambiguities: Rishabh drugged her tea and was in her office at 9:50 pm, so sedative in her blood points at him. Himanshu deleted the exact ten minutes around the killing. Priya is hiding that she is Meher's niece.

result.reveal_story: Here is the truth. Meher Qureshi was really Sunita Rathod. She was the engineer blamed for the Chotila mine wall collapse of 2016. Nine workers died there. One was Veer Sodhi. Veer was Nikhil Sodhi's elder brother. Three weeks ago Nikhil matched her face to an old clipping. Tonight he decided. At 9:40 pm Rishabh drugged her tea flask, because her safe held a fuel book with his name in it. At 9:50 pm he stood at that safe while she watched him, groggy. At 10:20 pm Himanshu called his wife in Leh, which is banned, and later cut ten minutes from the log. At 10:35 pm Nikhil called Meher on handset four and asked her to check the shed heater. She walked out in her indoor jacket. He hit her head with a steel torch inside the doorway, dragged her into the snow and bolted the door. The torch is still in his locker. And Priya? Priya was her niece.
